registryEntry.label: EO Automation Service Principal
evidence_commands: $app = Get-MgApplication -Filter 'appId eq ''{appId}''' | Select-Object -First 1; $sp = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter 'appId eq ''{appId}''' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($app -or $sp) { [pscustomobject]@{ AppId = '{appId}'; ApplicationObjectId = $app.Id; DisplayName = $(if ($sp) { $sp.DisplayName } else { $app.DisplayName }); Id = $sp.Id; ServicePrincipalType = $sp.ServicePrincipalType; AccountEnabled = $sp.AccountEnabled } | ConvertTo-Json }
